properties.description:
`report_manual_work` writes it; `manual_work_report` reads it back; the `capture-session` skill asks for it at session end. Delivers `req:a-session-says-what-it-did-by-hand-that-reflow2-already-serves`.

📌 DISTINCT FROM THE TWO THE GUARD OFFERED, BY ROLE. `req:a-session-says-what-it-did-by-hand-...` states WHAT MUST BE TRUE. `dec:idea-can-reflow2-see-the-work-a-session-did-by-hand` is the open QUESTION the requirement was promoted out of, and keeps the roads not taken. This is the thing that DELIVERS the requirement — what a capability is, and what a `SATISFIES` edge needs on its other end.

⭐ WHY IT IS WORTH MORE THAN AN ABSENT CALL. Every other measurement reflow2 has of its own adoption looks at what a session DID with it. `dec:bl-155` measured 40 of 132 tools never called and states the consequence outright: it **cannot tell unused from unreachable**. Hand-rolled work discriminates between them because it carries INTENT — a session that wrote a script to do X proves somebody wanted X, at a moment, badly enough to build it.

⭐ THE `diagnosis` IS THE WHOLE VALUE AND THE SET IS CLOSED. `tool_missing` (nothing does this — build one) · `tool_not_found` (something does and the session missed it — a DISCOVERABILITY failure, a different repair) · `tool_refused` (one was reached for and would not) · `unknown` (the session cannot say). Unknown values are REFUSED and the refusal names what would have worked. `unknown` is kept as a legitimate answer because forcing a guess corrupts the other three.

Naming a `reflow2_tool` the surface does not serve is refused too — that means the diagnosis is really `tool_missing`, and a phantom would sit in the one table somebody reads to decide what to improve. That check lives at the TOOL rather than in the core, because `tool_router.has_route()` asks the live router while a core-side list would be a second copy of the tool surface maintained by hand.

ALL THREE LEGS SHIPPED TOGETHER, deliberately: the surface audit hours earlier found 13 declared types with no legs at all and five carrying all three and still unused. The reader is the leg whose absence kills vocabulary — `DECOMPOSES` reached zero edges while shipping a detector for them.

🛑 TWO LIMITS THAT BUILDING THIS DID NOT RESOLVE. It depends on the agent having NOTICED the tool existed, which is the same blind spot it exists to see — so an empty report is NEVER evidence that nothing was hand-rolled, and `manual_work_report`'s own description says so. And `dec:how-should-reflow2-log-its-own-usage` argues a tool is the wrong shape for self-measurement at all, which is correct and here unavoidable: the server observes calls, and work done by hand happens where it cannot look.

🛑 THE RECORD STAYS LOCAL. `what` is free text naming the user's own domain — exactly the field `req:telemetry-carries-usage-never-design-content` warns "the next contributor will put something useful in". It must never be lifted into a telemetry payload.
properties.name: A session records the work it did by hand, with the diagnosis that separates a missing tool from an unfindable one
